  • TYLOO is formed.
  • November 30th - TYLOO part ways with alex and GoodRifle while adding Savage from TYLOO.raw and P1rate. [1]
  • January 26th - TYLOO part ways with P1rate while signing KingZ as his replacement. [2]
  • October 6th - karl announces his retirement and leaves TYLOO, who sign Mo as his replacement. [3]
  • March 2nd - TYLOO announce their transition to Counter-Strike: Global Offensive while signing Rita, HZ, and qhz to replace Savage, tb and xf, who all retire from competition. [4]
  • April 10th - TYLOO replace Rita and HZ with fancy1 and qz. [5]
  • May 13th - qhz and qz leave TYLOO. [6]
  • May 14th - TYLOO sign HZ. [7]
  • August 18th - TYLOO part ways with HZ and wudixt while signing forget and Attacker. [8]
  • March 18th - TYLOO part ways with forget, KingZ, and Attacker while signing somebody, DD, and qz. [9]
  • February 26th - TYLOO replace qz with Attacker. [10]
  • March 11th - TYLOO sign Karsa as coach. [11]
  • January 9th -TYLOO bench AttackeR and fancy1, release Karsa, and briefly suspend somebody, alleging the quartet violated the organization's poaching rules by contacting other organizations regarding a potential transfer. [12]
  • February 23rd - fancy1 announces free agency and leaves TYLOO. [13]
  • March 13th - TYLOO sign HZ. [14]
  • March 15th - TYLOO' transfer Attacker to Flash Gaming while acquiring BnTeT from Recca Esports. [15]
  • September 29th - TYLOO bench HZ while acquiring bondik on loan from HellRaisers. [16]
  • November 9th - peacemaker leaves TYLOO to join Heroic. [17]
  • January 4th - HZ is acquired by ViCi Gaming. [18]
  • January 5th - bondik's loan comes to an end and he returns to HellRaisers. [19]
  • January 18th - TYLOO acquire xccurate from Recca Esports. [20]
  • May 21st - AE joins the team on loan from TSGaming E-Sports Club while Mo recovers from an injury. [21]
  • October 9th - AE's loan ends and he returns to TSGaming E-Sports Club. [22]
  • December 31st - TYLOO release captainMo and DD. [23]
  • January 1st - TYLOO acquire Summer and Attacker on a three-month loan from Flash Gaming. [23]
  • January 11th - Johnta joins TYLOO as coach. [24]
  • April 28th - TYLOO part ways with Johnta. [25]
  • June 6th - TYLOO sign Freeman and DANK1NG, the latter as a stand-in. [26][27]
  • June 14th - TYLOO bench xccurate. [28]
  • July 29th - xccurate is loaned to Big Time Regal Gaming. [29][30]
  • September 4th - TYLOO bench Attacker and move DANK1NG into the starting lineup. [31]
  • September 21st - TYLOO release DANK1NG and reinstate Attacker into the starting lineup. [32]
  • October 19th - KingZ joins TYLOO as a trial coach on loan from Team Aster. [33]
  • December 22nd - BnTeT is acquired by Gen.G Esports. [34]
  • January - TYLOO acquire KingZ from Team Aster after he successfully complete his trial. [35]
  • January 10th - TYLOO sign xeta. [36]
  • April 14th - TYLOO sign SLOWLY. [37]
  • April 21st - TYLOO bench Freeman and xeta while signing DANK1NG. [38]
  • June 8th - xeta leaves TYLOO and retires from competitive Counter-Strike: Global Offensive. [39]
  • October 2nd - xccurate returns to TYLOO's bench after Big Time Regal Gaming disband. [40]
  • January 14th - xccurate is acquired by NG Esports. [41]
  • April 9th - Karsa rejoins TYLOO as an assistant coach and analyst. [42]
  • February 1st - TYLOO acquire BnTeT from EXTREMUM. [43]
  • February 15th - somebody retires from competitive Counter-Strike: Global Offensive and is moved to TYLOO's bench. [44]
  • February 21st - TYLOO part ways with KingZ and promote Karsa to head coach. [45]
  • April 8th - Karsa steps down from TYLOO. [46]
  • May 5th - TYLOO sign LETN1 as their new coach. [47]
  • September 24th - TYLOO part ways with BnTeT and bench Attacker. Additionally, they acquire aristo from Lord Rabbit Gaming and Freeman from YK Gaming, respectively. [48]
  • November 17th - TYLOO bench aristo while Attacker returns to the starting lineup. [49]
  • December 16th - SLOWLY steps down from the roster for personal reasons while aristo returns to the starting lineup. [50]
  • January 14th - TYLOO sign soLo as an assistant coach and analyst. [51]
  • May 25th - TYLOO acquire emi and ROGA from Partizan Esports, sk0R from IHC Esports and bench Attacker, Summer, DANK1NG, and aristo while SLOWLY is brought back into the active roster. [52]
  • September 18th - TYLOO part ways with LETN1. [53]
  • September 28th - TYLOO part ways with emi, ROGA, and soLo. [54]
  • October 2nd - TYLOO bench the remainder of their lineup while signing 5yclone as their new starting roster alongside zhokiNg as an analyst. [55]
  • October 10th - TYLOO loan somebody and sell Summer to Rare Atom, respectively. [56][57]
  • October 24th - sk0R is acquired by The Huns Esports. [58]
  • November 1st - SLOWLY is transferred to TYLOO VALORANT. [59]
  • December 1st - TYLOO sign aumaN. [60]
  • December 31st - TYLOO part ways with somebody upon the end of his contract. [61]
  • January 5th - zdr joins TYLOO on a trial basis. [62]
  • March 8th - lyrics3 joins TYLOO on a trial basis. [63]
  • April 11th - lyrics3 leaves TYLOO. [64]
  • May 1st - Freeman's contract expires and he leaves the team. [65]
  • May 16th - TYLOO part ways with advent and aumaN. [66][67]
  • May 17th - TYLOO part ways with kaze and Air. [68][69]
  • June 13th - TYLOO sign Jee. [70]
  • June 19th - TYLOO bench zdr. [71]
  • August 3rd - TYLOO sign Starry. [72]
  • August 4rd - TYLOO promote zhokiNg to head coach while k4Mi becomes the team's assistant coach and analyst. [73]
  • November 20th - TYLOO bench JamYoung. [74]
  • December 26th - Starry is acquired by Lynn Vision Gaming. [75]
  • January 11th - TYLOO reinstate JamYoung to the starting lineup. [76]
  • February 8th - TYLOO reinstate Attacker to the starting lineup. [77]
  • December 30th - TYLOO transition Attacker to an assistant coach position following his retirement from playing. [78]
  • January 9th - TYLOO acquire zero from Change The Game. [79]

Trivia

[edit]
  • The team's name is inspired by a Chinese mythical hybrid creature, the Tianlu (天禄).
  • It was the first Asian team to place Top 10 in HLTV's weekly rankings when they did so during the first week of August 2018. [82]
